title: Answer: consciousness is what integrated world modeling is like

statements.text: Consciousness is what it is like to be a process that generates integrated models of system and world with spatial, temporal and causal coherence, iterated as a stream of estimates conditioned on a causal world model.

sources.quote: claims that phenomenal consciousness is “what it feels like” when likely patterns of sense-data are inferred from probabilistic generative models over the sensorium of embodied-embedded agents
